__prompts__.description: Short description (also used as the Homebrew formula `desc`)
__prompts__.github_owner: GitHub user or org that owns the repository
__prompts__.default_branch: Default branch that CI and coverage run on
__prompts__.rust_workflows_ref: Ref of that repo to call (a tag, a SHA, or `master`)
__prompts__.enable_coverage: Publish the coverage HTML report to a `coverage` branch
__prompts__.enable_audit: Run the cargo security audit job in CI
__prompts__.enable_nix: Build the Nix flake package in CI
__prompts__.enable_wasm: Build and test a wasm (web) target in CI
__prompts__.enable_pages: Deploy the wasm build to GitHub Pages on tag
__prompts__.enable_crates: Publish the crate to crates.io on tag
__prompts__.enable_docker: Build and push a multi-arch Docker image on tag
__prompts__.enable_homebrew: Bump a Homebrew tap formula on tag
__prompts__.enable_wix_msi: Build a Windows .msi installer on tag
__prompts__.docker_image: Docker Hub image (`owner/name`); used when enable_docker is yes
__prompts__.homebrew_tap_repo: `owner/repo` of the Homebrew tap; used when enable_homebrew is yes
__prompts__.homebrew_license: License declared in the Homebrew formula
